title: 3.8.18 Lab: Save a State Object by Key
description: Turn a state object into JSON text and store it under a key so it survives the page closing. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create the state object
steps.instructions: Create a variable called state holding an object with at least two properties, for example a score and a level.

steps.title: Store it under a key
steps.instructions: Use localStorage.setItem to save the object under a key you choose. Remember the store holds strings, so the object has to be converted with JSON.stringify first.

steps.title: Read the key back
steps.instructions: Use console.log with localStorage.getItem on the same key to confirm text was stored.

requirements.title: State object declared
requirements.description: Declares an object with curly braces. Help: 3.8.15 (Saving by Key)

requirements.title: Converted with stringify
requirements.description: Calls JSON.stringify before storing. Help: 3.8.15 (Saving by Key)

requirements.title: the stored text is state turned into JSON and it is printed back
requirements.description: The line printed from localStorage.getItem is the JSON text of state. Help: 3.8.15 (Reading: Saving by Key)
requirements.hint: Store JSON.stringify(state) under a key, then print localStorage.getItem with that same key. Storing the object itself or other text would not match state.

checks.expr: state !== null && typeof state === 'object' && Object.keys(state).length >= 2 && output.some(l => { try { return JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(l)) === JSON.stringify(state); } catch (e) { return false; } })
checks.fail: The printed line should be the JSON text of state: save JSON.stringify(state) under a key and print localStorage.getItem with the same key.
